name: 90403 · Santa Monica, CA
findings: ZIP 90403 (Santa Monica) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90403 (Santa Monica) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 41 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
